keyframe_review.note: New keyframe (Cliopatria has no Brakna row). The Brakna and Trarza, both Banu Hassan subgroups, "established the emirates after their victory in the Char Bouba war (1673-77)"; the infobox gives only "17th century". The page names no town, river or region beyond "southern Mauritania", so the Brakna region stands for it.

notes:
Emirate of Brakna, additions batch af-03-x; Cliopatria has no row. Page: Emirate of Brakna (one page).

The page is thin: no capital, no town, no river, no French treaty, no end beyond the 1902 protectorate (infobox); 1677 is the year the Char Bouba war ends on the page and the founding is "after" it. The History of Mauritania page dates the Char Bouba war 1644-1674, a conflict that the Brakna page does not share. The 1856 French treaties (Faidherbe) that the Mauritania history mentions for Trarza and Brakna were not on any page opened and are not in the ledger. The Abdul Kader war has no year on the Brakna page.
Gazetteer: Aleg (capital of the Brakna region), Char Bouba.
